result.difficulties:
Five places where the rules did not fit cleanly:
1. There is no verdict for a zero-element placeholder (L210). I chose ENTAILED by construction.
2. There is no reason code for an unstated field that no declaration reaches except as NON_CLAIMED (L193). I chose COVERAGE as the nearest.
3. The reason codes have no precedence order, so I set my own tie-break.
4. RC-29 (on a fillable row the chosen member is NARROWED_CHOICE) conflicts with the RC-18 bar from GF2's V1 NOT_AUTHORED. I let the bar win.
5. The ASSUMED rule says 'a declaration reaches it' without saying which kind. I counted the owning contract's CLAIMED.
The forward result for a matched element with an absent field has no defined code, so I used UNMET for REQUIRED items and a vacuous SATISFIED for SUPPORTING ones. RPC-001-19.b against the game's 'long kick' depends on reading RC-34 verbatim.
